text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped by about 40%. Most of that time went to prep for the next visit.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were more complete, and next steps were logged the same day instead of "when I get to it."

**3. Managers coached differently.** Searchable call summaries let leads spot patterns, like which objections kept stalling deals.

**4. Trust took work.** Some customers hesitated at first. Asking consent upfront and explaining how data is handled fixed it.

**5. It wasn't magic.** Summaries missed nuance, so reps still reviewed them.

Our takeaway: AI handles the record-keeping. Humans still own the relationship.

What's your team seeing with AI note-takers?
